update_message.en: A new version of Time to Rogue is available.

news.title: Play on iPhone and Apple Watch
news.message: Time to Rogue is playable on iPhone and Apple Watch. Continue the same run on either device, then check your Focus from the iPhone widget or Watch complication.

tips: If a monster is two tiles away and your Focus meter is cyan, Wait. It will step into range, letting you attack first.
At low Focus, a monster that moves next to you can ambush immediately for 50% extra damage.
The dungeon gets harder in two ways: enemies scale with depth, and taking too many real-world days to descend makes later floors even tougher.
You can hold only three items. Do not hoard them, using an item costs no Focus and gives monsters no turn.
You can reverse time at most three times per run. Each use rewinds one turn.
Use a Surge right away when you get it. Its +1 Attack lasts for the rest of your run.
Kills at low Focus grant 50% more XP. The danger can be worth it.
Reaching the stairs below 45% Focus grants a 70% Focus refund.
